name: Brass Locker Key
description: A brass key numbered 17, placed inside a paper envelope by Lena, the ferry ticket office clerk. Used to access a north locker at the ferry terminal.
narrative_significance: The key serves as a delivery mechanism for a mysterious envelope numbered 17, delivered by an anonymous courier before the tide turns. It represents a covert transaction at the ferry terminal and appears connected to urgent, secretive business involving Lena.
